title: Chapter 78 The Eve Of Return
content:
Chapter 78 The Eve Of Return

These nomads have just experienced a great war. Many cattle and sheep have escaped because no one is grazing them. This winter is another winter of lack of food and short clothes. I don’t know how many people will freeze to death and starve to death.

The tribal leaders of those nomads just wanted to celebrate that they had repelled the attack, and gave a severe lesson to the arrogant and ruthless Royal Army.

But suddenly they heard the report from the sentry cavalry they had arranged in the south, and Yuguo had another 200,000 army marching northward, and this time the offensive was even more violent.

Because of the previous scouting reports, they are already familiar with the form and terrain of the grassland, and they know where there are more grassland tribes.

The annihilation battle can be carried out by excluding tribes with a larger number of people, aiming at killing more people, or burning more of their gathering places.

Fight the war potential of those nomadic tribes as much as possible, so that they will have less force to organize a counterattack every time. Gradually, they will no longer be able to organize an army that can be used to commit crimes in the south.

This time the Northern Expedition, because of the experience of the last time, and because of the victory of the last war, those nomadic tribes had a little bit of carelessness.

Therefore, the results of the battle are even greater, and the nomad population killed by him is more than half a million. Of course, his own losses are also greater.

Of the 200,000 people, only his 50,000 people were left, and he fled back under the siege of nomadic tribes who had killed too many relatives by those troops and were anxious.

Afterwards, the third and fourth Northern Expeditions were carried out one after another, and the entire 800,000 recruits went through one round, but the results of the battle slowly declined under the precautions of the nomadic tribes.

It has become 200,000, more than 100,000. With precautions, it is already difficult to reduce the war potential of those nomads if they want to kill a large number of people.

However, after this year-long war, the population of nomads in the entire north has changed from the original two million to the current one million.

And their food, because there was no grazing for a year, caused a large number of people to starve to death. In the second year, they were destined to be famine for more than a year.

After such a long war, Zhong Yu couldn't hold on any longer. Although he had enough food and grass, after such a long period of consumption, he also consumed most of it.

In addition, civilians from all over the Central Plains were formally drawn out in order to deliver food and grass to those troops. They lacked enough strong men due to the long-term war.

Construction in various parts of the Central Plains has stagnated, and some places are even worse than before the war, and have regressed a lot. If it weren't for the battle reports from the front line, most of them were news of their own country's victory.

Under the prestige of their own soldiers, the careerists have some concerns in their hearts. I am afraid that many people can't bear it anymore and want to rebel and overthrow this brutal country.

Of course, the 800,000 army has lost more than half of it in the war of more than a year, leaving only 200,000 people, but they are all elites.

And after more than half a year of living in the grassland, all of them have learned not too bad riding skills, and their riding and shooting skills are not too bad. That is their special skill for chasing and fleeing to win credit. !

How can you neglect it? After learning these skills well, one can make one's own life more secure, and after being able to make one's army win, one can obtain more results when chasing and killing.

So without too much supervision from their generals, they learned it by themselves, and they felt that the effect was more effective than others' forcing.

After defeating these nomadic peoples, the goal of my military training will also be achieved. With 200,000 Northern Expedition troops and 200,000 elites who conquered the Central Plains, I have 400,000 elite soldiers.

Coupled with the talents he has continuously recruited and cultivated from all over the Central Plains, he has already obtained enough civil servant talent reserves for him to rule thousands of counties.

There are also technical talents who have been forced to migrate to Luoyang City from various places, and there are also hundreds of thousands of him.

It can be said that the purpose of my coming to the Three Kingdoms has been basically completed, and it is time to go back. In this extremely small world, I feel constrained and feel uncomfortable doing anything.

There are more than 500,000 technical talents, together with their family members. In addition to the family members of the civil servants, the family members of the soldiers themselves have about 3 million people, who need to exchange luck points to the main world.

And because the Three Kingdoms world is a very low-key small world, which is too different from the world of gods and demons where the main world is located, if you want to fully exchange those soldiers into the world of gods and demons, you need to supplement their background.

Since those civil servants, generals, soldiers and craftsmen do not have extraordinary power, their exchange conditions are only equivalent to those of an ordinary refugee.

One luck point can be exchanged for ten, and the Three Kingdoms world is insufficient, so one luck point can be exchanged for fifty, which means that I need to make up for the 4/5 of their lack of luck points.

And those civil servants, military generals, soldiers and artisans have extra surcharges for special skills because they already have them, so they can save their huge exchange fees and just exchange them as ordinary people.

Just like a junior scribe, he originally needed ten luck points to exchange for one, but he already had knowledge in the Three Kingdoms world. Among the ten luck points, five extra exchanges including knowledge can be removed.

In addition, they don't have those extraordinary powers, and the 4.9 luck points belonging to that extraordinary power can also be saved. It only needs to be exchanged for 0.1 luck point of an ordinary refugee.

As for their extraordinary strength, such things as Wen Qi, they can slowly cultivate after returning to the main world, and they will be able to cultivate it sooner or later.

So, according to the main world's exchange standard, how much luck would it take to exchange his 3 million ordinary refugees? If one point is changed to ten, it will cost him 300,000 luck points.

And minus the share they already had, then multiplying 300,000 by four would require him to have 1.2 million luck points. If he destroys the Three Kingdoms world by himself, he can probably get about 1.5 million luck points.

It can also profit him 300,000 luck points, which can be said to be a very good harvest.

So, what I need to do now is to call all the generals I trust. Explain to them your current situation, about to leave this world, and the broader world of gods and demons you are going to.

Use this to attract them, let them follow you to a wider stage, and achieve greater achievements. Deception and coercion are always not sustainable.

So I plan to tell them everything, whether to come with me or not, it's up to them to choose. If you don't go, I will give them a county territory so that they can live better in this world.

In the end, more than forty generals, led by Sun Jian, Cao Cao, Liu Bei and others who had greater ambitions, chose to follow their emperor and go to the broader and more exciting world in his mouth.

Of course, their family will also move there with the emperor, for their peace of mind. Let them help him fight more sincerely and restrain them. He can still afford the luck points of hundreds of people in each family of these generals.
